# TerminusDB documentation index

Generated by `scripts/sync-terminusdb-docs.js` on 2026-10-06. Do not edit by hand.

- Source: [dfrnt-labs/terminusdb-docs-static](https://github.com/dfrnt-labs/terminusdb-docs-static) at commit `2c05cb93a0ba` (2026-08-04); rendered at https://terminusdb.org/docs/
- TerminusDB server release at sync time: **v12.0.7** (2026-08-10)
- Curated pages are committed in this directory. Every other page is written to `_all/`, which is gitignored; if a file is missing locally, run the script or open the source URL.
- "Updated" is the upstream page's own `lastUpdated` field where it has one.
